pricing.description.text: SAIPEN is free and open. There is no hosted service and no paid plan today; this page says exactly that.

pricing.badge-note.text: a statement of fact, not a price list

pricing.protocol.today.text: MIT-licensed, [public on GitHub]({repository}). Never paywalled, never behind an account.

pricing.local.today.text: Everything runs on your machine. There is no entitlement check and none is planned.

pricing.tools.today.text: The [ecosystem](/ecosystem/) projects are public repositories; see each one's licence.

pricing.hosted.today.text: Does not exist. No endpoint, account or billing surface.

pricing.future.title.text: If a hosted service ever exists

pricing.future.body.text: It would charge for optional managed infrastructure — hosted execution, persistent shared state, relay, evidence retention, observability, organisation controls, support — and never for access to the protocol or its specification. The local, open path would not be weakened to push anyone towards it. Until such a service exists, this page will not show a monthly price, a seat count or a "contact sales" button.

pricing.support.body.text: Support is completely optional. A donation buys no entitlement, unlocks no feature, is not a subscription, is not payment for the protocol, and does not affect access to SAIPEN. The protocol, documentation, and local use remain free.
